blurb: The Bethalto Historical Museum is housed in the original Village Hall, located at the corner of Main and Oak Streets in our downtown district. Built-in 1873 and enlarged in 1885, the two-story brick Victorian/Italianate town hall is the oldest governmental building still in use in Madison County.
